title: Join {organization}
body: You've been invited to join {organization} on Satis as {role}.
signInPrompt: Log in or create an account with the email the invitation was sent to, then accept it.
emailMismatch: This invitation was sent to a different email. Log in with the right account to accept it.
unavailable: This invitation is no longer available. Ask an admin of the business for a new one.
